title: The byte order mark is not a character of the text, so it is not counted
notes: After the double-quoted scalar "x" only white space, a comment or a line break can follow, so the y is the first character that cannot belong to a valid document. It is the seventh character of the decoded text; counting the byte order mark as a character would make it the eighth. Every convention for pointing at the error (the character, the end of the scalar before it) gives 7 when the mark is not counted. Positions are 1-based lines and columns counted in characters of the decoded text; the position of an error is the first character that cannot belong to any valid document (docs/case-format.md).
